summary: Sam Parker humorously recounts deciding to run his first marathon after announcing it at a family dinner on September 15th, 2023. He describes his training with friend Laura, odd fueling with jelly beans, long Saturday runs, setbacks, and the running community's advice. The narrative reaches marathon day on October 22, 2023, and cuts off as the starting gun sounds.
one_line: Sam Parker comically narrates training for his first marathon with friend Laura, from a family dinner announcement to the starting gun on October 22, 2023.
key_facts: Sam Parker announced at a family dinner on September 15th, 2023 that he would run a marathon, and his brother Jeremy nearly spat out his spaghetti.
Sam Parker describes himself as the king of couch potatoes whose idea of a workout was sprinting to catch the bus.
His inspiration came on a rainy Tuesday in late September from a rerun of the documentary "Boston Marathon: Triumph Over Tragedy."
His colleague Bob "Marathon Man" McMasters boasted about his recent 26.2-mile marathon at the office water cooler, which also motivated Sam.
Sam recruited his friend Laura, a semi-regular jogger, as his running buddy with the promise of post-run pancakes.
Sam and Laura followed a "couch to marathon" program that Sam compares to something designed by a deranged fitness robot.
Jelly beans "formulated for athletes" were the main part of Sam's fueling regime, and a runner's high he felt one Saturday turned out to be a sugar rush from them.
Saturdays were long run days, with playlists ranging from "Eye of the Tiger" to the entire discography of Abba.
During a hill workout, an elderly lady told Sam he moved like a "graceful tortoise," which got him going again.
Sam ran 10 miles without stopping for the first time, and Bob McMasters reminded him he still had another 16.2 miles to go.
Sam struggled with chafing and received tips from the running community such as "nipple guards are a gift to mankind."
Marathon day was October 22, 2023, with crisp weather and a clear sky; Laura, his family, and Jeremy, who had gained newfound respect, came to cheer him on.
